review.tagline: OpenAI's reference PyTorch code and weights for contrastive image-text embeddings
review.summary: CLIP is a Python package that loads OpenAI's pretrained image-text models and exposes encode_image, encode_text and a similarity forward pass. It supports zero-shot image classification from natural-language labels and feature extraction for linear-probe training. The README targets PyTorch 1.7.1 or later on CUDA or CPU, with weights downloaded on demand.
review.audience: ML engineers needing image-text embeddings or zero-shot classification
strengths: Small API: clip.load, clip.tokenize, encode_image, encode_text
Zero-shot classification from text labels without task-specific training
MIT license; runs on CPU or CUDA GPU
README has runnable zero-shot and linear-probe examples on CIFAR-100
weaknesses: Inference and evaluation only; no training code in this repo
Installed from git via pip; no tagged releases
Text context length defaults to 77 tokens
Larger independently trained models are in OpenCLIP, not here
needs: Needs PyTorch 1.7.1+, torchvision, ftfy, regex, tqdm
Models: CLIP ViT-B/32, other names via clip.available_models()
